data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 states the contradiction relation holds 'if and only if' 1dced5d5a8ff claims any answer other than 18, then specifies the mechanism as 'a competing empirical enumeration that either tests the wrong progression or terminates prematurely before reaching 18.' But the 'iff' is too strong for this mechanism: an answer like 53 also differs from 18, yet need not arise from testing the wrong progression or premature termination — it can arise from correctly enumerating the right progression x≡18 (mod 35) and selecting a later member. So the named mechanism does not cover every answer≠18 that the biconditional implicates; the proposed covering principle (one unique minimal positive solution ⇒ contradiction with all non-18 answers) and the empirical-enumeration mechanism diverge, leaving the relation under-justified for cases in the same residue class.
